speech.heard: In the USA, the upper middle class holds 22.6% of national income. In Brazil, it's 19.8%. The USA gives its fourth income quintile a steady share near global norms. Brazil limits that fourth quintile to under a fifth of total income. Together, they highlight how upper middle class earnings vary across the Americas. Across the world, North Macedonia leads at 24.8%, while Mozambique sits lowest at 18.8%. Data reflects the share of income or consumption accruing to each population quintile. How much income does the upper middle class hold in your country?
